en: A sepia-toned postcard image showing a prominent medieval castle with cylindrical towers, known as the Maschio Angioino (or Castel Nuovo), in the background. In the foreground there is a large equestrian statue on a pedestal, a public square with people walking, a tram, and leafy trees framing the scene. The postcard has a border and the caption 'NAPOLI - Maschio Angioino' printed at the bottom left.
